item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay III: The map notes said the parcel's many per-unit condo lots share its footprint; the DataSF parcel data has only the parcel itself, so the claim was replaced with a correction. The 353-383 King St address and 260 units now cite the DataSF Assessor roll, the 'three phases along King St' note was reduced to what AvalonBay's release says, the 2009 grand-opening milestone links the release, and the 2007 milestone links the SocketSite post and no longer says the building topped out.
item.description: The map notes said the parcel's many per-unit condo lots share its footprint; the DataSF parcel data has only the parcel itself, so the claim was replaced with a correction. item.title: Milestone · Avalon at Mission Bay III: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105300277 (17 stories, 260 dwellings, 353/383 King St) as completed. This is the permit's closure date, not an opening date. (Aug 14, 2009)
